items.information: # Português ### ATENÇÃO: ESSA COMPETIÇÃO NÃO TERÁ A MODALIDADE 3X3X3 **A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:** * Se estiver participando pela primeira vez, [leia o regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição e aprenda a competir [assistindo o vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); * Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; * Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal; * Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; * Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$35,00 pagos antecipadamente por meio de depósito bancário ou pix. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia do campeonato. **Pix 282.098.828-80**; * Enviar comprovante de pagamento para o e-mail [helga_zavrisko@yahoo.com.br](mailto:helga_zavrisko@yahoo.com.br). **Inscriçoes so serão confirmadas após o envio do comprovante.**; * Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail [helga_zavrisko@yahoo.com.br](mailto:helga_zavrisko@yahoo.com.br), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail [mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org); * Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, WCA, seus parceiros e apoiadores do campeonato utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. # English ### ATTENTION: THIS COMPETITION WILL NOT INCLUDE THE 3X3X3 EVENT. **The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements:** * If this is your first time competing, [read the WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition and learn how to compete by [watching this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-81VRLyYhbQ); * Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; * There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian; * Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind; * Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$35,00 paid in advance by bank transfer or Pix. Registration at competition day will not be allowed. **Pix 282.098.828-80**; * Send proof of payment to [helga_zavrisko@yahoo.com.br](mailto:helga_zavrisko@yahoo.com.br). **Registrations must be confirmed after sending the voucher.**; * For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, [helga_zavrisko@yahoo.com.br](mailto:helga_zavrisko@yahoo.com.br), or the delegate via email [mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org); * By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYwNjkzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7162b523f784c51046f6b75d1b0dd70bca9fa6c7/image.png)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU5MDQyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4cb58b9882a96f08b772fdbe40b22da459dd42c3/amcm_lateral.png) ### 🇧🇷 Português Atenção: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar. Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PampulhaOpen2026/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$25. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. ### 🇺🇸 English Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate. In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization. Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PampulhaOpen2026/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. The registration fee is R$25. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

organisers.name: [{Darren Saito}{mailto:hachi05ds@gmail.com}] [{Jason Zheng}{mailto:jizheng621@gmail.com}] [{Parth Garg}{mailto:parth.garg.sr@gmail.com}] [{Siyuan Liu (刘思源)}{mailto:syl.siyuan@gmail.com}] [{Tina Xiangyan Jin (金香延)}{mailto:tjin@worldcubeassociation.org}]

items.information: * We will be giving out free Penn Cube Day tote bags for competitors. * Current UPenn students are entitled to free registration. Please leave your Penn email in the registration comment and pay the fee. We will refund if you are qualified. * We will have newcomer (competitors attending their first competition) podium for 3×3, based on the result of 3×3 round 1. * We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event because there are no set times for each group. If your first event is later in the day, you do not have to arrive until then. Missing your group risks potential disqualification from the event. * Groups will be posted and sent in an email a few days before the competition. When it is time to compete, groups will be called instead of individual participants. * Food and drinks are NOT permitted inside the main room. You may eat elsewhere in Houston Hall. There are a few restaurants within a ten minute walk/drive. * Live results will be posted on WCA Live.

items.name: Poly Cubed at Pomona 2026
items.information: The incredible sequel to 2025's hit competition, Poly^3 @ Pomona 2026 will have more competitors, more cubes, and more popular events! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PolyCubedatPomona2026#68012-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. All attendees under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM5MTEzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--46ca470428704f3721815eb9f2d89e841eb13ec4/Saipan%20Open%202026%20logo.png) ### Håfa Adai, and welcome to the first ever competition in the Northern Mariana Islands! 🇲🇵 This competition serves as the premier competition for speedcubing in the Northern Mariana Islands. We welcome participants of all ages, skill levels, and nationalities to participate. * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need. * If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 11:20 AM. --- ### 하파 아다이! 북마리아나 제도에서 열리는 첫 번째 대회에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 🇲🇵 이 대회는 북마리아나 제도 최고의 스피드큐빙 대회입니다. 모든 연령, 실력, 국적의 참가자를 환영합니다. * 자리를 확보하려면 가능한 한 빨리 등록하는 것이 좋습니다. * WCA 규정을 꼭 숙지하세요. 공식 대회에 처음 참가하시는 분이라면 이 [영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8)이 필요한 정보의 대부분을 제공해 드릴 것입니다. * 처음으로 경쟁에 참가하는 경우 오전 11시 20분에 시작되는 경쟁자 튜토리얼에 참석하는 것이 좋습니다.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM3MDMxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--580e15233f5c8e3065f8116ca9163a7eba4d3743/Picture1.png) WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulSpring2026#67366-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulSpring2026#67365-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오. 모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulSpring2026#67366-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulSpring2026#67365-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.
